item.title: Dr Majed bin Mohammed Al Ansari, Adviser to the Prime Minister and Foreign Ministry spokesperson, warned at the weekly briefing in Doha tha…
item.description:
Dr Majed bin Mohammed Al Ansari, Adviser to the Prime Minister and Foreign Ministry spokesperson, warned at the weekly briefing in Doha that the Gulf escalation poses a "grave danger" not only to freedom of navigation and the global economy but also to the chances of a US-Iran agreement. He announced a meeting with Iranian officials within hours "as part of mediation efforts and an exchange of views on the current proposals", urged all sides to show restraint, affirmed continued coordination with Saudi Arabia and the UAE, and said it is in no one's interest to "remain in this situation and enter a stalemate".
Sources: Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/qatar-warns-gulf-escalation-poses-grave-danger-and-announces-new-talks-with-iran · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/17/11/2026/qatar-iran-to-hold-meeting-today-as-mediation-efforts-continue

item.title: The QE Index closed Tuesday at 10,079.41, down 27.59 points (0.27%), after trimming morning losses of 0.86%. Investors traded 116.04 millio…
item.description:
The QE Index closed Tuesday at 10,079.41, down 27.59 points (0.27%), after trimming morning losses of 0.86%. Investors traded 116.04 million shares worth QR305.99 million in 21,240 transactions; market capitalisation fell to QR616.97 billion from QR619.11 billion. Qatar National Bank slipped 0.6%, with 13 gainers, 36 losers and 4 unchanged.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/17/11/2026/qatar-stock-market-closes-lower-as-index-falls-027 · Business Recorder (Reuters) https://www.brecorder.com/news/40449367/gulf-bourses-close-mixed-as-shipping-security-concerns-linger

item.title: Qatar told the Fourth Committee of the 81st UN General Assembly in New York, in a statement by Sheikh Jassim bin Abdulaziz Al-Thani, Second…
item.description:
Qatar told the Fourth Committee of the 81st UN General Assembly in New York, in a statement by Sheikh Jassim bin Abdulaziz Al-Thani, Second Secretary at the Permanent Mission, that the only guarantee of lasting peace in the region is a just and comprehensive solution to the Palestinian cause based on two states, the 1967 borders and East Jerusalem as capital. It called the settlements illegal under Security Council Resolution 2334 and condemned the late-October incursion into Al-Aqsa Mosque and the 12 November targeting of the surgical department at Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/17/11/2026/qatar-affirms-that-a-just-and-comprehensive-solution-to-palestinian-cause-is-only-guarantee-of-lasting-peace-in-region

item.description:
The Ministry of Education and Higher Education approved 331 new professional licences, 14 for school leaders and 317 for teachers and coordinators, through the Professional Licensing Section at its Training and Educational Development Centre, while tightening assessment quality through approved standards, results review and field visits.

The Qatar Meteorology Department forecast misty to foggy conditions in the evening and early morning from Wednesday 18 November through the end of the week, with possible reduced visibility, and urged drivers to take care.

Qatar took part in the 20th Francophonie Summit of heads of state and government in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, from 14 to 16 November, with a delegation led by H E Sheikh Ali bin Jassim Al-Thani, Ambassador to France and Representative to the International Organisation of La Francophonie.

item.title: Qatar face South Korea in a friendly at 5:00 p.m. Tuesday at Abdullah bin Khalifa Stadium. Korea are ranked 32nd in the world against Qatar…
item.description:
Qatar face South Korea in a friendly at 5:00 p.m. Tuesday at Abdullah bin Khalifa Stadium. Korea are ranked 32nd in the world against Qatar's 60th, and play under interim coach Robert Moreno in his sixth and possibly last match, after a 3-2 defeat to Saudi Arabia on 13 November.
Sources: Korea JoongAng Daily https://www.koreajoongangdaily.com/sports/taeguk-warriors-look-to-close-out-tumultuous-year-with-win-against-host-qatar/12973830

item.title: Explosions were heard over Manama on Tuesday morning after Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they launched combat drones in a "precision ope…
item.description:
Explosions were heard over Manama on Tuesday morning after Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they launched combat drones in a "precision operation" against a US-operated radar at Sheikh Isa Air Base, calling it a response to US drones violating Iranian airspace. Bahraini state TV said the armed forces intercepted the "Iranian aerial attacks"; Bahrain and US Central Command said the drones were intercepted with no damage, and the Interior Ministry later announced the all-clear. It was the third drone attack on Bahrain in five days.
Sources: The Siasat Daily (AFP) https://www.siasat.com/blasts-in-bahrain-as-irans-irgc-claims-strike-on-us-radar-3579491/ · Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/qatar-warns-gulf-escalation-poses-grave-danger-and-announces-new-talks-with-iran

item.title: Saudi Arabia's Foreign Ministry, in a statement carried by the Saudi Press Agency, condemned the repeated Iranian attacks on Bahrain as a v…
item.description:
Saudi Arabia's Foreign Ministry, in a statement carried by the Saudi Press Agency, condemned the repeated Iranian attacks on Bahrain as a violation of international law and good-neighbourly principles, affirmed full solidarity with Bahrain and its right to protect its security, and called for an immediate halt to all Iranian attacks on countries in the region and room for diplomacy.
Sources: Arab News https://www.arabnews.com/saudi-arabia/saudi-arabia-condemns-repeated-iranian-attacks-on-bahrain-3012505

item.title: Omani Foreign Minister Sayyid Badr bin Hamad Al Busaidi received his Iranian counterpart Abbas Araghchi in Muscat; they discussed preventin…
item.description:
Omani Foreign Minister Sayyid Badr bin Hamad Al Busaidi received his Iranian counterpart Abbas Araghchi in Muscat; they discussed preventing further escalation and reviving dialogue and negotiations, stressed safeguarding maritime routes and uninterrupted international shipping and trade, and agreed to keep political and diplomatic channels open.
Sources: Oman Observer https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1199812/oman/oman-iran-stress-maritime-security-amid-regional-tensions · Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/qatar-warns-gulf-escalation-poses-grave-danger-and-announces-new-talks-with-iran

item.title: Iran's navy said a fourth oil tanker caught fire and was heavily damaged after hitting a naval mine east of the Strait of Hormuz while sail…
item.description:
Iran's navy said a fourth oil tanker caught fire and was heavily damaged after hitting a naval mine east of the Strait of Hormuz while sailing in a restricted area with its navigation system off, and warned against transiting without coordinating with its forces. UKMTO reported a separate attack on a tanker about seven nautical miles off Oman's Khasab that left it unable to manoeuvre with an engine-room fire; Euronews said the tanker was struck a second time on Tuesday.
Sources: Oman Observer https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1199814/world/region/iran-reports-fourth-tanker-damaged-in-hormuz · Republic World https://www.republicworld.com/world-news/fourth-oil-tanker-catches-fire-in-hormuz-after-hitting-naval-mine-iranian-navy-2026-11-17-141199 · Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/qatar-warns-gulf-escalation-poses-grave-danger-and-announces-new-talks-with-iran

Oman and Uzbekistan identified proposed investment projects worth about $5 billion during the Uzbek president's state visit; companies from both countries signed 20 agreements and MoUs at the Oman-Uzbekistan Business Forum and Exhibition at the Oman Convention and Exhibition Centre, covering industry, energy, mining, transport and logistics, food security, tourism, space technology and artificial intelligence.

item.title: Gulf bourses closed mixed on Tuesday as investors weighed the tanker attacks: Abu Dhabi rose 0.9% to 9,771 and Dubai 0.6% to 6,248, helped …
item.description:
Gulf bourses closed mixed on Tuesday as investors weighed the tanker attacks: Abu Dhabi rose 0.9% to 9,771 and Dubai 0.6% to 6,248, helped by Emaar Properties (+1.3%); the Saudi index slipped 0.1% to 10,253 as Aramco fell 1.4% trading ex-dividend; Kuwait gained 0.1% to 9,019 and Muscat lost 0.2% to 7,356.
Sources: Business Recorder (Reuters) https://www.brecorder.com/news/40449367/gulf-bourses-close-mixed-as-shipping-security-concerns-linger

item.title: Flight disruption to Saudi Arabia continues: on Tuesday flydubai cancelled flights to Abha, Dammam and Riyadh, Air Arabia its Sharjah-Abha …
item.description:
Flight disruption to Saudi Arabia continues: on Tuesday flydubai cancelled flights to Abha, Dammam and Riyadh, Air Arabia its Sharjah-Abha and Sharjah-Riyadh services, and Etihad keeps Abu Dhabi-Riyadh and Dammam flights cancelled through 19 November while Jeddah flights operate. Qatar Airways resumed Riyadh on 13 November and Dammam on 14 November, and Saudia and flyadeal run some Riyadh services via Qassim Airport with bus transfers.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/business/aviation/uae-flights-status-update-saudi-cancellations-continue-as-gulf-tensions-rise-latest-delays-for-november-17-1.500750212

item.title: The Dubai Government announced the Eid Al Etihad holiday for its employees from Wednesday 2 December to Friday 4 December 2026, five consec…
item.description:
The Dubai Government announced the Eid Al Etihad holiday for its employees from Wednesday 2 December to Friday 4 December 2026, five consecutive days with the weekend, with work resuming on Monday 7 December; private-sector employees get two paid days off on 2 and 3 December.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/dubai-announces-five-day-holiday-for-uae-national-day-1.500750680

item.title: The Kuwait-New Zealand Joint Cooperation Committee held its second meeting in New Zealand, with Kuwait's delegation led by Assistant Foreig…
item.description:
The Kuwait-New Zealand Joint Cooperation Committee held its second meeting in New Zealand, with Kuwait's delegation led by Assistant Foreign Minister for Americas Affairs Abdulaziz Al-Qadfan; it discussed expanding bilateral ties and regional and international developments, and the two sides agreed to hold the third meeting in Kuwait.
Sources: Kuwait Times https://kuwaittimes.com/article/53807/kuwait/kuwait-new-zealand-stress-continued-coordination-at-joint-committee-meeting/

item.title: The Egyptian Exchange ended Tuesday broadly lower: EGX30 fell 0.99% to 51,681.62, the small and mid-cap EGX70 2.42% to 17,592.75 and EGX100…
item.description:
The Egyptian Exchange ended Tuesday broadly lower: EGX30 fell 0.99% to 51,681.62, the small and mid-cap EGX70 2.42% to 17,592.75 and EGX100 2.03% to 23,535.06, on turnover of about EGP 9 billion. Market capitalisation lost about EGP 56.9 billion to close at EGP 4.09 trillion; Egyptians were net sellers of about EGP 222.1 million while Arabs (EGP 107.8 million) and foreigners (EGP 114.3 million) were net buyers, and Talaat Moustafa Group fell 1.8%.

item.title: Foreign Minister Dr Badr Abdelatty, Industry Minister Khaled Hashem and EBRD President Odile Renaud-Basso, in the presence of Prime Ministe…
item.description:
Foreign Minister Dr Badr Abdelatty, Industry Minister Khaled Hashem and EBRD President Odile Renaud-Basso, in the presence of Prime Minister Dr Mostafa Madbouly, signed an MoU creating a platform to attract and govern green-transition investment in industry, aiming to speed up emissions cuts and expand renewables, clean technologies and energy efficiency to make Egyptian industry more competitive abroad.
Sources: Elzaman News https://www.elzmannews.com/547703

item.title: Prime Minister Dr Mostafa Madbouly, on the sidelines of the World Economic Forum meeting in the New Capital and with the investment ministe…
item.description:
Prime Minister Dr Mostafa Madbouly, on the sidelines of the World Economic Forum meeting in the New Capital and with the investment minister present, met Jay Shroff, head of UPL Group, which has invested $110 million through Hytech Egypt International for Seeds to expand seed production and plans soil and technology studies to make Egypt a seed-production hub; Madbouly stressed food security, grain productivity and water scarcity.
Sources: Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7184203

item.title: Egypt were held goalless by Malawi through the 75th minute at Bingu National Stadium in matchday 4 of 2027 AFCON qualifying, after Mohamed …
item.description:
Egypt were held goalless by Malawi through the 75th minute at Bingu National Stadium in matchday 4 of 2027 AFCON qualifying, after Mohamed Salah hit the post in the 70th minute, Omar Marmoush was denied one-on-one in the 63rd and Trezeguet missed two chances.
Sources: Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7184273

item.title: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced an "unprecedented" strike on the Kerch Bridge linking Crimea to Russia using long-range d…
item.description:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced an "unprecedented" strike on the Kerch Bridge linking Crimea to Russia using long-range drones and Neptune and Flamingo missiles; Ukraine's General Staff said an arch and part of the road section collapsed, severing the road link while the rail line still stands. Russia's Defence Ministry said it downed 1,441 drones in a second night of major attacks, and Russia hit two main Dnipro bridges in Kyiv with seven ballistic missiles, killing at least two people.
Sources: Spectrum News (AP) https://spectrumlocalnews.com/nc/coastal/international/2026/11/17/ukraine-strikes-russia-s-kerch-bridge

item.title: US Vice President JD Vance told Fox News that President Trump will not let the confrontation with Iran become a "forever war", declining to…
item.description:
US Vice President JD Vance told Fox News that President Trump will not let the confrontation with Iran become a "forever war", declining to set an "artificial timeline", as the US sent a third aircraft carrier to the Middle East while maintaining its naval blockade of Iran, which Trump said he will keep in place.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/americas/trump-will-not-let-iran-become-a-forever-war-vance-1.500749867 · Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/qatar-warns-gulf-escalation-poses-grave-danger-and-announces-new-talks-with-iran

item.title: Wall Street awaits Nvidia's results after Tuesday's close, with analysts expecting EPS of $2.47 on revenue of $109.15 billion versus $1.30 …
item.description:
Wall Street awaits Nvidia's results after Tuesday's close, with analysts expecting EPS of $2.47 on revenue of $109.15 billion versus $1.30 and $57 billion a year ago; interim CEO Colette Kress will host the call. Before the open, Nvidia rose 1.1% and Nasdaq-100 futures 0.46% while Dow futures fell 0.57%; Disney gained about 2% after beating estimates, and Home Depot reported revenue of $43.4 billion and named CFO Richard McPhail CEO effective 23 November.
Sources: Yahoo Finance https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-tuesday-november-17-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-nvidia-earnings-091546152.html

item.title: Europe's STOXX 600 fell 0.8% and MSCI's global equity index 0.4%, with European tech down 1.6% on new US chip curbs, while the dollar hit i…
item.description:
Europe's STOXX 600 fell 0.8% and MSCI's global equity index 0.4%, with European tech down 1.6% on new US chip curbs, while the dollar hit its strongest since April 2025. St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem said several rate hikes may be needed to curb inflation, and markets price a December hike with a slim chance of a 50 basis-point move.
Sources: Rallies (Reuters) https://rallies.ai/news/european-shares-fall-nasdaq-futures-inch-up-ahead-of-nvidia-earnings-bb1b6ab20217e935

item.title: Brent rose 0.4% to $92.76 a barrel after a morning dip to $91.66, and is down 22% this month as Gulf flows return to pre-war levels and the…
item.description:
Brent rose 0.4% to $92.76 a barrel after a morning dip to $91.66, and is down 22% this month as Gulf flows return to pre-war levels and the IEA expects a fourth-quarter surplus. Goldman Sachs sees Brent averaging $88 in 2027 and falling to $78 by December 2027; the US Strategic Petroleum Reserve fell to 276.4 million barrels, the lowest since August 1982, and OPEC+ meets on 29 November to set 2027 policy.
Sources: Business Recorder (Reuters) https://www.brecorder.com/news/40449367/gulf-bourses-close-mixed-as-shipping-security-concerns-linger · FinanceFeeds https://financefeeds.com/brent-crude-oil-price-91-66-tuesday-goldman-glut-warning-bull-96-bear-88/ · Euronext (Reuters) https://live.euronext.com/en/financial-news/oil-prices-caught-between-rising-mideast-exports-and-tanker-attacks

item.title: Anthropic nears the largest IPO in history: 825 million shares are due to price in a $70 to $78 range on 18 November, with Nasdaq trading u…
item.description:
Anthropic nears the largest IPO in history: 825 million shares are due to price in a $70 to $78 range on 18 November, with Nasdaq trading under ANT from Thursday 19 November, raising about $64.4 billion at the top of the range at a fully diluted valuation of up to $1.405 trillion, plus a $26 billion private placement by seven compute suppliers.
